coordinate_system.world: Right-handed, rink-centred, calibrated geometry only. See docs/geometry.md.
coordinate_system.origin: Centre of the inner board boundary (midpoint of its long and short extents) on the top surface of the ice sheet (z = 0).
coordinate_system.x_axis: +x along the rink's long axis, toward the goal that appears at the image-right end of stiga_se_fi_overhead (goal.E).
coordinate_system.y_axis: +y across the rink, toward the image-top long side of stiga_se_fi_overhead (boards reading Divello ... Coca-Cola ... Comfort).
coordinate_system.angles: Degrees in data. Rotation about +z, counter-clockwise seen from above; 0 deg = facing +x.
coordinate_system.image_pixels: Source-image pixels: u right, v down, origin at the image's top-left corner; pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1). Pixel data never counts as millimetres without an image_to_world mapping.

assumptions.statement: The ice-side edge of the near-black strip at the base of the boards is the ice contact boundary.
assumptions.reason: The strip (median 14.8 px wide) could be a base trim, a gap over the loose sheet or a shadow; the photograph does not show which.
assumptions.replace_with: Close-up or measurement of the installed board base on the user's game.

assumptions.statement: Where the edge is hidden or disturbed, the boundary is interpolated (along the rays) between the nearest detected edge points on either side.
assumptions.reason: A few short stretches are disturbed by painted markings meeting the boards or fail the local consistency test; the neighbouring edge is continuous.

assumptions.statement: The official overhead views the ice plane nearly perpendicularly, so a similarity (no perspective) maps ice-plane pixels to the world.
assumptions.reason: Opposite traced sides are parallel within 0.22 deg; see validation/05-board-report.json. Elevated parts (board tops, screens, figures) do show perspective and are excluded.
assumptions.replace_with: Homography from a perpendicular overhead with scale markers in both directions.

assumptions.statement: The catalog playing length (approx. 845 mm) equals the traced inner boundary's long extent; one uniform scale is applied to both axes.
assumptions.reason: Only a preview scale is needed before calibration; the catalog does not say what the 845 mm spans.
assumptions.replace_with: Measured inner board length and width of the user's game.

image_traces.method: scripts/trace-board.ts: flood fill of the ice from seed 2818,1650 bounded by max(R,G,B) < 90; 1440 rays from the ice centre; sub-pixel crossing of the ice/strip mid-level; robust line (4 sides) and circle (4 corners) fits; every 2nd ray stored.

inferred_segments.reason: Interpolated between the nearest detected edge points (bottom_left): model residual -2.7 px; model residual -2 px.
Interpolated between the nearest detected edge points (top): not_ice_inside; local deviation -4.9 px.

image_traces.note: Ice-contact edge of the installed boards (inner base). Not the board top rail, not the outer housing, not the loose sheet perimeter (hidden under the boards).

image_to_world.note: PREVIEW ONLY. 0.179597 mm/px uniform; origin at the traced boundary centre; +x along the fitted long axis toward image-right; +y toward image-top. Implied width 468.8 mm vs catalog approx. 457 mm. Ice plane only; never apply to elevated objects.

world.note: Shape traced from the overhead; size from an ASSUMED uniform preview scale. Not calibrated millimetres.

board_height.note: Height of the boards above the ice.

inner_boundary.note: Ice contact boundary of the installed boards, traced provisionally from stiga_se_fi_overhead (see docs/board-trace.md). Corner radius and length stay unknown in mm until measured; pixel values are in validation/05-board-report.json.

playing_area_nominal.note: Catalog figure; whether it equals the inner board boundary is unverified. Not to be stretched to the housing size.

outer_housing.note: Black molded housing. Outline not traced.

thickness.note: Only a '25% increase' is advertised (guide p. 1); no absolute value.

loose_sheet.note: Loose ice sheet (manual part 7111-0393-01). Its perimeter may extend beneath the boards and is not the playable boundary.
